subject: QBR prep: ops roadmap snapshot, launch timetable & key delivery risks
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Levin <sarah.levin@acmecorp.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR prep: ops roadmap snapshot, launch timetable & key delivery risks

Team —

As we lock the QBR deck, I want a concise operational snapshot for the exec readout on Friday. Please review the attached snapshot and the risk draft I started (launch_risks.md). High-level asks below: 

- Laura: update the timeline table (tab 2) with the final cutover windows and callouts for migrations. If dates are uncertain, mark "TBD - blocker" and add owner.
- Marcus: highlight any infra capacity constraints (GPU pool / Dedicated overflow) that would change SLO commitments.
- Kimberly: summarize any open third-party dependencies (cloud marketplace, telemetry hooks) and expected procurement lead times.
- Vivek: I need a 2–3 line recommendation for the exec slide: go/no-go posture given current risks.

Also looping in Sarah from Acme to confirm their readiness for the integration pilot — Sarah, if you can confirm the test account availability by Wed EOD that helps finalize timeline.

Attachments: QBR_Roadmap_Snapshot_v2.xlsx (master table) || launch_risks.md (working list) || acme-integration-MAP.pdf

Thanks —
Ava
Ava Chen
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Levin <sarah.levin@acmecorp.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 13:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: ops roadmap snapshot, launch timetable & key delivery risks

Thanks Ava — quick update from product timelines: 

- Tab 2 updated: pushed the public launch from 2027-04-18 to 2027-05-02 (soft window) due to two delayed client integrations. I left the internal engineering cutover unchanged for now.
- Marked two items as "TBD - blocker": OAuth consent from Acme (Sarah) and schema finalization for user telemetry.
- Added owners for all TBD lines (Marcus for infra, Kimberly for procurement).

Next steps: I'll freeze the timeline by Wed 12:00 so the deck has a single authoritative table. Marcus/Kimberly — if you see something that prevents that freeze, highlight it here.

Laura
VP, Product
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Sarah Levin <sarah.levin@acmecorp.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: ops roadmap snapshot, launch timetable & key delivery risks

Ava / all — infra notes: 

- Short answer: we have marginal capacity for the pilot in the Dedicated pool through April, but sustained production traffic in May will require either a Reserved burst window or re-routing some workloads to Hosted during ramp.
- Risk: autoscaler tests (JIRA-OPS-2142) still show a 95th percentile spike at 180ms above our latency SLO under synthetic mixed workloads. If we can't reduce that via batching/kv-cache by April 20, we should plan the May ramp as staged with traffic caps.
- Mitigations: 1) schedule an infra stress test Wed (I've assigned eng: ops-squad), 2) provide temporary burst capacity from Partner pool (cost impact noted in the snapshot), 3) prioritize kernel selection work (engineering ticket in the deck).

I'll update the spreadsheet with capacity numbers and tagged action rows.

Marcus
Director, Infrastructure
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Sarah Levin <sarah.levin@acmecorp.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: ops roadmap snapshot, launch timetable & key delivery risks

Adding procurement perspective: 

- Acme marketplace listing is ready, but legal redlines on the indemnity clause delay contract signature by ~10 business days unless we accept an alternate clause. I've attached a short note in the Drive link.
- Telemetry vendor (PulseMetrics) requires a PO + SOC 2 attestation before we enable production hooks. We can sign an interim MSA to allow pilot telemetry; full rollout needs the attestation.
- Estimated procurement lead time for full rollouts: 15 business days after PO + legal clearance. For the QBR timeline that means we should call the May 2 date "pilot-only" and aim for general availability late May pending SOC 2 completion.

Kimberly
Head of Procurement & Partnerships
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Levin <sarah.levin@acmecorp.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 17:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: ops roadmap snapshot, launch timetable & key delivery risks

Thanks — good concise thread. My recommendation for the exec slide: 

- Posture: Proceed to QBR with a "conditional go". Present May 2 as a pilot launch with staged ramp to GA (target late May) conditioned on two deliverables: 1) successful infra stress test (Marcus) showing latency mitigation path OR scheduled burst capacity; 2) signed telemetry interim MSA (Kimberly) enabling pilot observability.
- Ask: I want two slide bullets with expected impact (latency, cost delta for burst), owner, and contingency (fallback to Hosted variants if Dedicated capacity tripped). Laura/Ava — please bake this into the deck and mark the slide as "conditional go" for Friday.

Vivek
SVP, Engineering & Operations
